core_obligations: Reduction and full faithfulness (proof lines 5962-5983): the statement is proven for sheaves of sets; (h_{-1})^{-1} is fully faithful with quasi-inverse h_{-1,*} (describe-pullback lemma), the same componentwise; the functor-description lemma lifts this to h^{-1} fully faithful with quasi-inverse h_*; U is a hypercovering in LC_qc because proper surjective maps are qc coverings; the simple-descent lemma gives a_{qc}^{-1} fully faithful with essential image the cartesian sheaves on the total site; a formal chase through the comparison diagram transfers full faithfulness to a^{-1} (see notes).

Essential image (lines 5985-6032): for a cartesian sheaf G on U_Zar, h^{-1}G is cartesian on LC_qc/U, hence h^{-1}G = a_{qc}^{-1}H; a six-equality computation evaluates (h_{-1})^{-1}(a_*G) - equalizer description of a_* (augmentation lemmas, first and fifth equalities), exactness of (h_{-1})^{-1} (second), proper push-pull for the proper a_0, a_1 (third), the identification a_{qc}^{-1}H = h^{-1}G (fourth) - and lands on H; hence h^{-1}G = h^{-1}a^{-1}a_*G and full faithfulness of h^{-1} concludes a^{-1}a_*G = G.
proof_roadmap: Transfer full faithfulness from the qc total site to the Zariski simplicial site through the comparison diagram.
Prove the essential image by the explicit equalizer computation evaluating (h_{-1})^{-1}a_*G = H.
difficulty_reason: Descent theorem (statement 5947-5960, proof 5962-6039): the topological LC twin of the chapter's etale descent theorems - full faithfulness transfers through the comparison diagram, and the essential-image half is carried by a complete six-equality equalizer computation with every step justified by a named lemma; the fully-faithful transfer is stated as a formal diagram chase (recorded in the notes). H2: formal descent bookkeeping over established descent lemmas.
